The argument shows that for any compact sets \(A,B\subset\mathbb{R}^2\) we always have  
\[
\bigl(d^{(l_p)}(A+B)\bigr)^p\le \bigl(d^{(l_p)}(A)\bigr)^p+\bigl(d^{(l_p)}(B)\bigr)^p,
\]
and the example with two‑point sets in orthogonal directions attains equality, establishing that the constant cannot be smaller than 1. Hence the optimal constant for \(p>2\) is indeed \(C_p=1\).
